meta.maker: Michele Coscia and Viridiana Rios (data); INEGI (boundaries, distributed by CONABIO)
meta.licence: data: no licence stated (the authors ask to be cited as Coscia & Rios 2012, CIKM); boundaries: INEGI, no licence stated in the CONABIO download
meta.note: Joined for this map: the authors publish a table only (municipality code x year x 10 cartel columns, 0 or 1, from web-search mentions). It was matched on the 5-digit INEGI code to INEGI's 2012 municipal areas (all 2,457 codes matched). Each municipality carries, per cartel, the list of years with a 1 (empty means never), so no value is lost. The authors note data before 2004 is less reliable. Boundaries simplified at 0.002 degrees (about 220 m).
